task.title: Correct direct model dragging and wheel focus
task.input: The existing real GLB assets and OrbitControls, and D20
task.accept: 1) A direct pointer-down in the product-card model viewport must capture the current model; hover must stop autorotation without geometrically scaling the card; ordinary wheel input scrolls the page, and only Ctrl/Cmd+wheel on a focused model or zoom controls zoom the model, without first forcing activation (E-97, E-98, E-99). 2) pointercancel/blur/Escape/unmount must all release control; subsequent manipulation must target the correct model without leaving the page locked; the user's pause takes priority over hiding/showing recovery; preserve tests that fail before the modification and pass afterward (E-100).
